import cmath

def polar_rect(r, theta):
    """
    Convert polar coordinates (r, theta) to rectangular coordinates.
    Returns a tuple containing:
    - A tuple of (magnitude, phase) as (abs(z), cmath.phase(z))
    - The complex number in rectangular form
    """
    z = cmath.rect(r, theta)
    return (abs(z), cmath.phase(z)), z
